messages.subject: Dynamic Energy Budget Shiny App
parts:
Dear NicheMapR users,

For those of you interested in DEB theory, I've made a prototype Shiny app that allows you to simulate growth trajectories at different temperatures and food levels for most of the ~2800 species currently in the DEB parameter database collection. It is essentially running the 'rundeb' function of NicheMapR. The main purpose is educational.

http://bioforecasts.science.unimelb.edu.au/app_direct/deb/

Any feedback welcome - there are bound to be some bugs and issues!

All the best,
Mike
